users.title: Team users
users.newDescription: Create an account for someone on the team and choose their initial profiles.
users.emailHint: The email this person uses to sign in to the dashboards.
users.profilesHint: Optional. The person only gets into areas where they have a profile; you can change this later.
howSteps: The account starts without a password, with a pending invite.
Set the password on the person's page (Account details) or wait for the email invite, coming soon.
The person can only access the areas of their profiles. You can assign or remove profiles at any time.
